items.title: MGM Resorts International (MGM) Stock Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: People Incorporated’s cancelled plan to acquire a 73.9% stake in MGM Resorts International (MGM) for US$9.3b in cash has left investors reassessing the stock’s standalone outlook. The cancellation hit short-term sentiment hard, with the share price down 3.3% on the day and the 30-day share price return falling 25.0% to US$32.58. items.title: Akamai Technologies Soars on Anthropic Deal; Costco Earnings Beat | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Akamai Technologies (AKAM) shares soar after the cloud provider inked a seven-year $11.6 billion deal to provide computing power to Anthropic. Analysts say the deal should boost Akamai's growth and its profitability profile looks attractive, given the contract is entirely focused on CPUs. - People (PPLI) shares jump on a report that MGM Resorts is discussing making a bid to purchase the Barry Diller-owned media giant. - Costco Wholesale (COST) quarterly profits surpassed Wall Street's estimates after the company recorded a benefit related to tariff refunds.
